faq_heading: Capitol Hill condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Capitol Hill. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Capitol Hill, Burnaby: 19 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 13 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Capitol Hill rose from 16 in June to 19 in October (+18.8%), and 7 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.5% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Capitol Hill?
Capitol Hill also had 34 houses listed and 3 sold in October, against 19 condos and townhomes listed. The Capitol Hill houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Capitol Hill home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

15 condos sold in Capitol Hill with a median price of $617,500 (the middle half sold between $496,500 and $856,500), taking a median of 48 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 33% sold above list. They had a median $799 per square foot, a median year built of 2012 and a median strata fee of $550 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Capitol Hill?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 19 condos and townhomes listed in Capitol Hill. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Capitol Hill a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Capitol Hill had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Capitol Hill from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 7 condos and townhomes sold in Capitol Hill over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Capitol Hill sell for?
faq.a: 15 condos sold in Capitol Hill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $617,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Capitol Hill?
faq.a: The median was 48 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (33% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
